d: Iran has denied allegations that its armed forces launched an attack on a key facility in Kuwait, with an IRGC spokesman insisting that no military or offensive operation was conducted. Meanwhile, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says diplomatic efforts led by Qatar and Pakistan are continuing, with proposals being examined to resolve tensions and reopen the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz.
